jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Azure/MS Data Fabric)
jobs.description:
Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft.

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
AI Labs is a sub-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self-serve access to the AI-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

Your Skills And Experiences

- BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
- Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
- Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C#, PowerShell, Python
- Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
- Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
- Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
- Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
- Proactive thinking, excellent problem-solving, and analytical skills
- Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
- Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
- Fluent in English

Preferred Skills

- Strong coding skills (e.g. C#, PowerShell)
- Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
- Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
- Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
- Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.
Responsibilities:

- Shape customer's architectural strategy to create a secure, scalable, and compliant cloud environment
- Act as a trusted advisor for the customer to ensure alignment with strategic goals, advocate customer's interests when working in a diverse team of various stakeholders, and promote cutting-edge cloud technologies.
- Design and adopt governance automation services by leveraging new technology paradigms (e.g. serverless, containers, microservices) and cloud best practices
- Work as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
- Producing technical documentation and architecture decision records.
- Implement DevOps practices such as infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployment
- Coordination of team resources to solve problems and technical issues
- Work in Agile (Scrum, Kanban), defining, estimating, and delivering stories
Mandatory Skills Description:

Python,
Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),
Microsoft Azure DevOps,
Microsoft Azure Services,
Microsoft Data Fabric,
Network,
IP Routing,
TCP/IP,
CI/CD
Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Proven experience of working with MS Data Fabric (DP-600/DP-700 certifications),
experience in building AI Landing zones,
experience with FabricIO & o365 agents,
C# proficiency, Databricks,
self-driven/self-motivated,
PowerShell.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer (.NET)
jobs.description:
## Who We Are

We don't just develop software; we build scalable products.

We develop Multi-Tenant SaaS infrastructures, microservices architectures, event-driven systems, and high-traffic integration platforms. Our products support a broad ecosystem consisting of e-commerce, payment systems, subscription management, customer engagement, notification infrastructures, and services tailored for various industries.

We are looking for a *Senior Backend Software Engineer* to join a team where code quality, software architecture, and sustainable system design are highly valued, and where technical decisions are truly made by engineers.

---

In this role, you will take an active part in processes such as:

•⁠ ⁠Developing microservices-based backend services.
•⁠ ⁠Architecture-level improvement of both new and existing services.
•⁠ ⁠Designing and developing event-driven systems.
•⁠ ⁠Developing third-party system integrations.
•⁠ ⁠Creating solutions focused on performance, security, and scalability.
•⁠ ⁠Conducting code reviews.
•⁠ ⁠Contributing to technical design processes.
•⁠ ⁠Establishing and implementing software standards.
•⁠ ⁠Providing technical mentorship to Junior and Mid-level developers.

---
